Auxiliary independently selected K_j with distributions lambda_{j,*} and conditional Jensen give the uniform Bernoulli upper bound, while a product-pure state attains equality. Exact binomial rearrangement yields 2n binom(n-1,floor n/d)(d-1)^(n-floor n/d)/d^n. Local CLT and Poisson point-mass convergence establish the stated limits; one-sided derivatives of F(lambda)=2e^-lambda lambda^floorlambda/floorlambda! yield positive jumps at integers. Independent exact scalar identities and direct small tensor matrix checks corroborate normalization, not a general proof.
